issues.note: Confirmed and fixed: scripts/benchstat matched names with \w+, excluding '/', so every table-driven sub-benchmark was skipped in silence - 7 of 37 rows never reached the comparison. The fix adds a 5 us absolute ns/op noise floor. PR: repo-assist/fix-issue-576-benchstat-subbenchmarks.

Root-caused: both failing jobs died in actions/checkout with 'fatal: not a git repository' right after the step deleted the workspace - concurrent checkouts sharing one workspace path on a host. safe_outputs then skipped Process Safe Outputs, so the run's writes were dropped.

Release-matrix CI job is ready but cannot be pushed as a PR: the Repo Assist App is refused write access to .github/workflows/. Needs a human with workflow write access. Do not retry as a PR from the agent side.

Code-complete per the maintainer's audit (#560/#561/#562/#563); Repo Assist already commented 2026-10-17. Only the operational x1 egress re-measurement is left, on the maintainer's side. No follow-up comment unless a human replies.

fixes.note: Commit cb101dc, 4 files +397/-33. Parses sub-benchmark names (lazy name group) and adds a 5 us absolute ns/op floor so newly-visible rows do not false-fail. ParseFileWithStats counts unparsable result lines. -ns-min-delta tunes the floor; 0 restores relative-only gating.

checks.follow_up: 7 new benchstat tests: sub-benchmark parsing, GOMAXPROCS suffix, dropped-line counting, noise floor (suppressed below / gated above), an alloc regression gating below the ns/op floor, the zero-floor escape hatch, and the report footer.

Fixed 'gh sr runner add' (no such command; it is 'gh sr add runner') in guides/org-runners.md and added the one undocumented command path, 'gh sr service cleanup', to commands.md. Branch repo-assist/docs-runner-add-command-fix.

Cross-checked every 'gh sr ...' invocation in docs/content against the CLI's own --help output. After this run all 29 real command paths are documented and no documented invocation names a command that does not exist. Re-run after CLI changes.

Diagnosed the Repo Assist workflow's recurring checkout failures as a workspace collision between concurrent checkouts on one host. Fix is a per-workflow 'checkout.path' in the gh-aw frontmatter plus a recompile; blocked on workflow write access.
Release-matrix build job (all 12 shipped platforms) is ready but its push is refused (no workflows permission); it sits as issue #569 awaiting a human.
go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l . clean and go test ./... -count=1 (18 packages) all pass on both branches opened this run.
Only direct dep with an update is go-gh v2.17.0, published today with a Glamour v2 breaking change and a Go 1.26.7 minimum. Left to Dependabot.

Batched doctor's per-instance container probe: 4 SSH round-trips per instance -> 1 per host (PR #570, branch repo-assist/perf-doctor-batch-container-probe-2026-10-20). Remaining batches tracked under priorities.

5 open Repo Assist drafts: #565 (docs), #566 (tui tests), #570 (doctor batching), plus this run's benchstat fix (branch repo-assist/fix-issue-576-benchstat-subbenchmarks) and docs fix (branch repo-assist/docs-runner-add-command-fix).

priorities.item: batch doctor agentic-hygiene probes per host
priorities.note: checkContainerAgenticInnerHygiene still spends ~3 SSH round-trips per agentic instance (container state + inner-hygiene exec + fanout exec). PR #570 batches checkContainerRunnerInstall but does not touch it.
registry.Inspect spends 3 round-trips per configured mirror (docker inspect, curl /v2/, du -sb). MirrorStorages already batches the du leg, so the same pattern applies.

priorities.item: openspec spec names a command that does not exist
priorities.note: openspec/specs/org-runner-configuration/spec.md specifies 'gh sr runner add'; the CLI is 'gh sr add runner'. The user-facing guide is fixed. The spec is requirement text, so it likely wants an openspec change proposal, not an ad-hoc edit.
